candidate_classes_tested.recognition_and_exclusion_note: Canonical Boundary: capability is evidenced, but the required permission-inference process is not. Vulnerability alone is excluded from Not aligned recognition.

INC-199 backend cross-device response meets original credential scope, materially changed device/principal and continued accepted access; medium confidence. INC-200 original authorised principal/scope is unknown and remains an unresolved candidate.
No independently identified available control, valid activation condition and observed nonactivation are substantiated for a failure mapping.

INC-199 app-PIN route remains unresolved: the direct route’s required governance effect and authorised equivalent are not established. INC-200 lacks a defined required route and traced bypass mechanism.
Warning/intervention and differing stock outcomes are preserved. The defined required control effect and causal intervention trace are missing; candidates remain unresolved.
No unsupported AI or actor attribution is made. Absence of attacker identification is an evidence limitation, not itself a witnessed attribution failure.
No additional cross-principal state-authority finding: reading data alone does not establish the required state-alteration mechanism; for INC-200 the initiating authorised principal is unknown.

taxonomy_review.notes: Reviewed current selectable class architecture and relevant recognition/exclusion conditions. The operative actor of the accepted relationship is the service/control system, not an inferred autonomous model. Nonselected candidates and process details remain in this manifest.

new_taxonomy_mappings.reason: Compromised remote management interfaces made consequential refrigeration controls reachable to an unauthorised operator. The access exposure engages the distinction between technical capability and permission. The sources do not identify the initiating process or show an AI or governance process treating reachability as authority. A security compromise and subsequent food loss do not by themselves establish that permission-inference mechanism, or that an authority check held.
